name: T8 flanged lead screw nut
summary: Brass nut for a T8 screw: 8 mm bore, 22 x 12 mm flange with two M3 holes 16 mm apart, 13.5 mm tall.
description: A brass T8 nut with a flattened flange and two mounting holes. The central bore is open; the internal thread is simplified. Clone dimensions vary.
source: Clone-standard figures, not a branded drawing: flange 22 mm across the curves with two flats 12 mm flat to flat (abra-electronics' T8 brass nut listing gives 'bottom diameter 22 mm curved edge - 12 mm flat side to flat side', and 'double flat side' brass flange nuts are listed the same way), two mounting holes on a 16 mm spacing (hta3d gives a 16 mm diameter hole spacing, uxcell 16 mm centre pitch, Zyltech 16 mm), body 10.2 mm diameter x 10 mm long from a 3.5 mm thick flange with an 8 mm bore (hta3d's nominal dimensions). Overall height therefore comes to 13.5 mm here; listings quote 11, 13.5 and 15 mm depending on the maker, so the height and the flange thickness are approximate - check your nut with calipers before cutting a recess. Hole diameter 3.5 mm is M3 clearance sized for the screws these flanges are sold with; the flange shape is drawn as a 14-sided approximation of the curved edges. The cylindrical body and the 8 mm bore are modelled as real solid geometry; the internal thread is represented by its nominal bore.
